note: Adapted from the species-level description of Mjöberg (1920); original in English; alate, soldier, worker and queen all present, the end of the worker section cut off in the excerpt; only measurements legible in the text are recorded; figure numbers not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Yellowish white, head bright reddish brown, mandibles black. Head much smaller than in M. serratus and shorter; postclypeus white at the apex, narrowing forward on both sides, slightly elongate in the middle; labrum less pointed than in M. serratus, apex more broadly rounded, hairy; mandibles much shorter than in that species, curvature slightly stronger, inner margin finely serrate; antennae 14-segmented, much shorter and more slender, extending slightly beyond the mandibular apices, segment 3 smallest, segments round and short, apical segment pointed; pronotum small, white, anterior margin with a weak ridge, narrowing from the broadly rounded anterior corners to the posterior margin; abdomen short, white. Body length 4.5 mm, head length 0.95 mm, head width 0.8 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Very similar to the workers of M. turneri and M. excisus. Head longer than wide, pale red-yellow; mandibles broad, left mandible with two large pointed apical teeth, a smaller pointed tooth below them and a distinctly projecting triangular base; right mandible with two large apical teeth, immediately below them a very broad and blunt tooth, base broad but not projecting; antennae short, white, hairy.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Entire body dark brown, mesothorax, metathorax and venter pale yellow. Head dark brown, postclypeus and mouthparts lighter, distinctly smaller than in M. turneri, sides and posterior margin rounded, vertex flat; compound eyes slightly smaller; ocelli circular, smaller than in M. turneri; postclypeus and labrum as in M. turneri; mandibles stout, left mandible with two very pointed apical teeth and one pointed tooth situated in the middle and directed backward, connected with the 2nd apical tooth by a sharp ridge, base triangular; right mandible with two very pointed horn-like teeth, but the middle tooth very broad and triangular, base broad and only slightly projecting; pronotum smaller, more convex, shorter, anterior corners broadly rounded, sides narrowing toward the base less sharply than in that species, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; wings small, narrow, venation variable, grey-brown, media running through the upper part of the wing, giving off an indefinite number of branches, forked at the apex; legs moderate, pale yellow; abdomen with parallel sides, with 10 tergites. Body length with wings 8.8 mm, body length 5 mm, head length 0.89 mm, head width 0.84 mm, fore wing length 7.2 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen white, head, thorax, legs and 7 tergites brown; abdomen cylindrical, sternites very small, lighter in the middle. Body length 20 mm, abdominal length 17.8 mm.
